title: PRESSER | Trinidad Chambliss - Postgame vs Wofford (11-21-26)
text: Uh, Trinidad, just to be able to go out there and have the performance you did today, uh, leading up to the Egg Bowl, which will be your last game here, where where do your emotions kind of stand? >> Um, just honestly just grateful, um, and just blessed. Those, uh, have been my emotions. Um, I have kind of been a little emotional, uh, ever since, you know, the OU game. um just kind of embracing it and just taking it all in that these are probably going to be the last times last couple weeks here um in Oxford and at Miss. So um yeah, man. But I'm just super blessed and just super appreciative like everyone that made it happen here for me and just, you know, along my journey here and uh hopefully we go out with a bang with, you know, getting a win versus you know, Mississippi State and then, you know, getting a win in the bowl game, too. >> Forgive me, you won't get to see you again till Friday. Just kind of your your second egg bowl. just what has this game kind of meant to you as a guy with a lot of guys who are now coming in experiencing it for the first time kind of one and done split for you a second time. >> I mean, you know, we don't like them, they don't like us. Um, it's huge for the people who came through Old Miss and uh I know a lot of people down at Mississippi State, you know, care about this game, too. And, um, it's been for the former players as well. And, um, I mean, Mississippi State versus Mississippi. So, um, what more can you not like about that? So, uh, that gets your blood going. And then um I know there's a lot of uh history with this game and you know even last year too with them taking my jersey um that kind of you know let the sour taste in my mouth still. So um just excited to play you know again with my guys and one last time in the vault too. So um just super excited for that. >> What's it like seeing Deuce Knight hurdle people? >> It's awesome. I mean in the wait room when we do like vert uh ver vertical uh test um I mean he gets the highest numbers out of you know everyone on our team. So, um, sometimes you can get too aggressive with it like he was today. Um, but I mean, he's he's a freak of an athlete and those are some of the things that he he he can do and, um, that you get out of deuce. Um, he can throw and he can also run. Um, and that just makes him, you know, a dynamic player and, um, you know, for future DC, it's going to be hard to scheme against scheme against them. So, um, yeah, Deuce is a freak, so it's cool to see him do that. >> And then just real quick, what was it like seeing Ferris State on the national stage today? >> So cool. Like so freaking cool. I feel like they've came so far uh as a program and um the people there have, you know, built a dynasty and um for them to have, you know, big noon kickoff at, you know, their first playoff game here um is awesome. I mean, they were, you know, the vibes were crazy. Uh my friends that I still got back at Ferris were sending me pictures and videos of it and it looked packed. Um they had all the the signs and stuff and it was sweet. So, um just super, you know, just super cool to see that, you know. I mean, it's a division 2 school. I mean, Big Rapids, Michigan is the middle of nowhere. So, um, happy for my old school >> with you could have having gone to the draft last year and done that whole thing. You you chose to do this on the whole. Has it been worth it to come back? >> 100%. Yeah, I wouldn't change a thing. Um, I'm super grateful for everything and I'm I'm the type of person that believes in everything happens for a reason. Um, you know, you got to see the good and the bad. Um, and it's like beauty in the struggle. Um, so you got to learn from, you know, your past experiences and, you know, past failures and, uh, just grow. I mean, that makes us, you know, who we are as as people in person. So, um, yeah, I mean, truly grateful for this year and, uh, wouldn't change it any other way. Um, the relationships that I've created, you know, the connections that I've that I've had, um, the experiences that I've had. I mean, it's unbelievable. I mean, I would have never thought that I'd be in the position that I am, you know, two years ago. So, I know I keep saying it, but I'm just super blessed and just super appreciative and just super grateful for everyone that made it happen. And I had some people uh asking me, so I'll ask you what what made it the the right call to to not do the senior day today. >> Um well, my dad just had back surgery like two weeks ago, so he's still back home in Michigan, still recovering. Um so it was like I that did it last year as well. My dad was here. Um my mom's here as well, so we had, you know, all the pictures taken, too. Um and so I just felt like it wasn't going to be right with my dad not being here. Um he was at home. Um he wanted to be here, but he just came with his back. So, um, I felt like, you know, I did it last year, had nice pictures. Um, probably wasn't going to do it again this year. >> I know it wasn't against an SEC opponent, but obviously Deuce has had Alexander has had a tough uh, stretch lately. Just how big do you think today is could be for I mean, mentally and just to end the season strong because I would think he's trying to go pro. >> Yeah. No, for sure. I mean, I can't speak for what Deuce is going to do. Um, but you know, happy to see him have a great game. Um, we know that he's capable of that. He's he's he's shown it, you know, throughout games this whole year. Um, but yeah, I mean, whenever you see, you know, one out there, it could be dangerous. And, you know, if I see him, you know, man, man, you know, I'm going to take that every time. So, um, happy for Deuce, happy that he had a great game. >> You guys came out, you threw five touchdowns, team put up 789 offensive yards, which if my numbers right, that's the second most in school history. >> Wow. uh what does that say about a breath of fresh air for you guys heading into the end of the season. >> Yeah, that's awesome. Um you know, you try not to get caught up in the stats or anything like that, but that's that's really cool. Um I'm glad that I was a part of that. Um and that just shows, you know, what this offense is capable of. Um you know, hopefully we have, you know, a good performance like that against Mississippi State and in our bowl game. Um but yeah, that's that's awesome. up top in the same way the same way you were talking about state a second ago and kind of part of that story and it's continuing for them uh what do you kind of think about as you're getting ready for final games here Mississippi State in the bowl game how forming yourself set up the viableness for it future and what's coming next year >> yeah um and that was another reason like why I came back too is so leave my mark, leave my legacy here and then also influence, you know, people and uh putting Old Miss kind of back in the conversations of, you know, a top SEC school. Um, and I feel like we've done that. You know, this year really hasn't gone the way we wanted it to, but I mean, every year is not going to be perfect. Um, but yeah, I mean, you know, I think that, you know, this staff and PG's doing a great job. You mean he's he's working his ass off. Sorry for my language, but I mean, he's working his butt off. Like, he really is. And I mean he's losing sleep over all these like little things that's happening and you know the losses and stuff but um yeah I mean this this program is in the right hands of PG and you know on the offensive side you know coach Judge JDB you know they're working their butt off as well too and um you know people are putting in you know a lot of work here and uh I feel like you know it goes unnoticed sometimes and you know it's easy to see the score or how you know if we lo we lose or not but I mean people are trying and they're working really hard. >> Last question up top. Yeah, Trinidad, you talked a little bit about the ball game as well with, you know, potential NFL draft aspirations in your future. Will you play in that bowl game if you know depending on what it is or is that something you'll make kind of week of? >> No. Yeah, 100%. I'm definitely planning it. I mean, to have another opportunity to play with my brothers that, you know, have worked their tails off just as hard as I have and the coaching staff as well. Um, the time and energy that they put in, I mean, I was never thinking about sitting sitting out that game. So, um, gives me another opportunity to put on the Old Miss uniform. So, I take that, you know, 10 out of 10 times. >> Awesome. Thank you so much.
